publisher: Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations
ownership: Official Florida corporate-registration public records distributed by the Division of Corporations through its public Data Access Portal
program_use_authorization: The Division offers free data downloads for informational purposes, documents custom-program use, and provides public portal credentials. Downloads are provided as-is and can change, be replaced, or be deleted.
source_access: Read-only SFTP using the publisher's public account. The password is supplied at runtime through FL_SUNBIZ_PUBLIC_PASSWORD and is never persisted in configuration, logs, fixtures, manifests, or artifacts.
allowed_use: official quarterly corporate filing archive acquisition
immutable internal retention of privacy-minimized selected-field source records
selection of rows explicitly coded A plus active organization and reported-principal-address normalization
redistribution of approved normalized factual fields with source attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: publishing rows coded I or representing source Active status as independent proof of current operations, legality, solvency, licensure, public access, or an open storefront
representing a principal address as a verified current physical operating site
representing the quarterly snapshot as every business operating in Florida or the United States
retaining or exporting FEIN, mailing-address, registered-agent, or officer fields from the 1440-character source row
retaining the unminimized source archive after selected-field extraction
embedding the public-access password in source code, configuration, logs, fixtures, manifests, or artifacts
merging organizations across sources without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations, quarterly corporate data download.
retention: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and approved normalized releases. Delete the unminimized archive after successful selected-field extraction and on acquisition or parsing failure.
redistribution: Only approved normalized factual fields are exportable, with source attribution, archive timestamp and checksum, provenance, field exclusions, and source-status/address limitations retained. The raw archive and selected-field source snapshot remain internal.
personal_data_handling: Corporate names and principal addresses are public registration fields but can identify an individual or residence. The connector parses only positions through the approved report-date fields and never materializes FEIN, mailing-address, registered-agent, or officer fields in a retained artifact.
